name: Receipt Tape
blurb: A thermal receipt prints down the left side, one line item per VO line (retail-store prices for the problem half), the TOTAL slams in red; on the turn it's torn off and a second receipt prints the DHgate order at a fraction of the price with a SCAM OR STEAL? stamp; B-roll plays in a big frame on the right throughout.
off_why: lv trainer 2026-10-23: the receipt column on the left ('LV RETAIL' line items with made-up prices) reads slow and dull next to the B-roll ('the motion graphic just doesn't seem as interesting over there')
